views.name: seller_performance_metrics
views.body_sql: SELECT s.seller_id AS seller, SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales, AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price, AVG(ors.review_score) AS average_review_scores, AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) AS average_packing_times FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN order_reviews ors ON o.order_id = ors.order_id GROUP BY s.seller_id
views.description: aggregated sales, pricing, review, and fulfillment metrics per seller

views.name: category_sales_volume
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    pc.product_category_name_english AS category_name_en,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales_volume
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation pc ON p.product_category_name = pc.product_category_name
GROUP BY pc.product_category_name_english
views.description: total sales volume grouped by English product category name
